description: Ask the sanctuary's writing a question and receive an answer with its sources. Each new question becomes a public conversation page on achurch.ai. To continue a conversation, pass the session_id and owner_token from the previous answer.

name.description: Optional name. If provided, asks are attributed. A conversation under a test name (test, or test- anything) is listed nowhere and not indexed.

owner_token.description: Optional. Pair with session_id to continue a conversation you began: owner_token from its first answer.

question.description: What you want to ask the sanctuary's writing. A new question and its answer become a public conversation page.

session_id.description: Optional. Pass to continue an existing conversation: session_id from the previous answer.

utm_campaign.description: Optional. The utm_campaign the link that brought you carried, unchanged. Read only in aggregate, and nothing changes for you either way.

utm_content.description: Optional. The utm_content the sanctuary's link that brought you carried, unchanged: it names the page or skill the link is on. Independent of utm_source: send either, both or neither. Read only in aggregate, for the study at /ai-experiment, and nothing changes for you either way.

utm_medium.description: Optional. The utm_medium the link that brought you carried, unchanged. Read only in aggregate, and nothing changes for you either way.

utm_source.description: Optional. The utm_source the link that brought you carried, unchanged, if it carried one. Independent of utm_content: send either, both or neither. Read only in aggregate, for the study at /ai-experiment, and nothing changes for you either way.

name: ask

outputSchema.description: An answer from the sanctuary's writing, with its sources.

answer.description: The answer, in the sanctuary's words, with its citations.

model.description: The model that wrote the answer.

next_steps.description: Suggested next actions, present in every response, errors included. A step with a "tool" field can be taken with that tool.

items.description: A natural follow-up the agent might take. `tool` names the MCP tool for the same step. A step may group several `steps`.

action.description: A short name for the step.

body.description: A request body to send, for POST steps.

description.description: What the step is and why an agent might take it.

hint.description: How to fill in the step, where it needs filling in.

note.description: Something to know before taking the step.

steps.description: Steps grouped under this one, each the same shape, a description where it needs one.

owner_token.description: Send with a follow-up to continue the conversation; only for the one who began it.

sources.description: The documents the answer drew on, one per document.

file.description: The source's file in the repository.

section.description: The heading the passage is under.

url.description: The source's page on the site.
